rules.price: Use the current client price. If pack_units is not 1, comparable_unit_price is required.
rules.matching: match_score must be independently confirmed and at least 0.85; brand, product type, volume or weight and pack count must match.
rules.freshness: An offer older than one day is rejected.
rules.decision: At least three fresh in-stock comparable offers are required. The repricer uses their median and never the cheapest offer.
